logs.imperative: Read the ADMIRAL_LOG (or the Commander spine state for a non-fleet run). Extract candidates from RULINGs, INCIDENTs, ADMIRAL ERRORs, and recoveries: what was improvised, what was relearned, what a template or skill should have carried. Cite the log line for each.
logs.finding: ADMIRAL_LOG.md read line-by-line. Grounded candidates: engine-self-edit-hazard pre-ruling (line 21) + successful execution (line 44: isolated worktree, pre-merge live-spine check, merge, checkout sync, continue on new engine); git update-ref working-tree skew self-caught-and-fixed (line 44); classifier veto on git reset --hard (line 44, Admiral's own action, NOT impl-182 as the brief's candidate-2 attributed -- correction noted); dispatch-shape ruling (line 22) matches existing admiral/SKILL.md:51 verbatim -- CONFIRM not new. HARD-band ordering RULING (line 39) is normal decision-class latitude working as designed, not friction. No ADMIRAL ERROR-tagged entries exist despite one qualifying incident (the ref/working-tree skew) -- it was folded into a MERGE entry's prose instead of using the dedicated ADMIRAL ERROR tag the log's own grammar defines for exactly this.

feedback.title: Audit the feedback entries
feedback.imperative: Read the AGENT_FEEDBACK entries for this run/epic. Extract candidates from friction, adherence deviations, and improvement signals. Weight friction the run worked around over friction merely asserted.

crew.title: Audit crew workflow feedback
crew.imperative: Read every crew Workflow Feedback section (IMPLEMENTER_RESULT / REVIEW_RESULT). Consolidate phrase-different duplicates. Handoff gaps reported by multiple crews are the strongest handoff-scope candidates.

telemetry.imperative: Cross-check candidates against telemetry: rework_count per task, BLOCK verdicts, waives/forced overrides, re-dispatches, incident counts. Mark each candidate corroborated or assertion-only; raise confidence only with corroboration.
telemetry.finding: Rework counts: #180 x2 (concurrency-test coverage nit closed), #181 x1 (naive-now TypeError BLOCK, closed). #179/#182/#183: 0 rework, APPROVE first pass. BLOCK verdicts: 1 (181-review.md, naive-now TypeError -- corroborates nothing in the candidate list directly; it's a closed defect, not a process lesson). No waives, no forced overrides, no incidents/collisions logged. Corroboration pass: candidate-2 (classifier denial) has exactly 2 grounded occurrences (180-result.md; ADMIRAL_LOG.md:44 Admiral's own action) -- telemetry-thin (assertion-level, not a counted metric) but consistent with the pre-existing LATITUDE_CONTRACT.template.md worked-example precedent, so corroborated-by-precedent not bare assertion. Candidate-3 (concurrency test hang) corroborated by the rework/fix commit itself (d15ee77 unrelated rework was for the OTHER nit; the concurrency fix was in the original delivery, verified 3x re-run + reviewer's independent 4-repeat run, 7 total green passes, 0 flakes) -- strong corroboration. Candidates 6/7 (engine-hazard handling, ref/working-tree skew) corroborate directly against ADMIRAL_LOG.md's own MERGE entry, single-instance but primary-source (not asserted secondhand).
